name: Neverwinter Nights Diamond
description: Neverwinter Nights Diamond is a singleplayer and multiplayer third-person role-playing game, bundling Neverwinter Nights, the first game in the Neverwinter Nights series, with its Shadows of Undrentide and Hordes of the Underdark expansions.

gog.store_details: This is the original 2002 Neverwinter Nights with both expansions and the premium modules, not 2018's 'Enhanced Edition'. Since October 2018, GOG only includes it as a bonus with the Enhanced Edition (per GOG's forums), but it's still an ideal candidate for restoring EAX sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Neverwinter Nights ships with EAX off and its 'DirectSound3D Hardware Support' sound provider, which has no EAX.

audio_settings.title: Enable 4.0 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Neverwinter Nights ships set to 2 speakers, so the rear speakers of a 4.0 setup get no sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 5.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Neverwinter Nights ships set to 2 speakers, so the rest of a 5.1 speaker setup gets no sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 7.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Neverwinter Nights ships set to 2 speakers, so the rest of a 7.1 speaker setup gets no sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable Pro Logic surround
audio_settings.reason: Neverwinter Nights ships set to 2 speakers, so a Pro Logic receiver has no surround information to decode.

audio_settings.title: Enable headphone sound
audio_settings.reason: Neverwinter Nights ships set to 2 speakers, so its sound isn't mixed for headphones.

sources.title: GOG: Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition release post
